result.reasoning: This commit (titled "fix(diag): prevent NullPointerException") refactored FastDiag.fd() to extract displayConstraintList() call results into local variables, but introduced two new NPE possibilities: (1) calling progressCalback.displayConstraintList(...) without first checking progressCalback != null, and (2) the null-check `if (displayConstraintListD != null)` guarding only displayConstraintListD while displayConstraintListC (used right below) was left unchecked. The follow-up fix commit ff5af72e0a73f76fb5e99692996351482792363c directly patches these exact two issues by adding `progressCalback == null ? null : ...` guards and adding `displayConstraintListC != null &&` to the condition, confirming this is the introducing commit.
